notes: Reference kind: surgery was indicated for poor IOP control or progression on medication; patients used glaucoma medications preoperatively (Table 2 R21, range includes eyes on none) and no washout is described.
Roles: the two stent models were allocated by commercial availability (XEN 63 first, then XEN 45) and neither is declared experimental; both are control groups.
Bleb needling was required in two XEN 45 eyes; the article does not state that they were removed from the visit means, so no outcome-defined exclusion applies.
Mean number of glaucoma medications per visit is tabulated in Table 2 R21-R24 (not extracted).
